children.name: Symbion americanus Obst, Funch & Kristensen, 2006

children.name: Symbion pandora Funch & Kristensen, 1995
children.description: Symbion pandora is a jug-shaped microscopic aquatic animal that dwells on the mouth-parts of Norway lobsters.
